kept=[]
def outer():
 count=0
 def words(value):
  nonlocal count
  count+=1
  result=value.lower().split()
  kept.append(result)
  return result
 seen=[]
 for word in words(' A B '):
  seen.append(word)
  if word=='a':kept[0].append('c')
 print(seen,type(kept[0]).__name__,count)

class Words:
 def __init__(self):self.count=0
 def words(self,value=' A B '):
  self.count+=1
  return value.lower().split()
class Text:
 def lower(self):print('lower');return self
 def split(self):print('split');return ['custom']
instance=Words()
saved=instance.words
print([word for word in saved()])
Words.words.__defaults__=(' C D ',)
print([word for word in instance.words()])
print([word for word in saved(value=Text())])
print(type(saved()).__name__,instance.count)
